sorγan-šira: Sorγan-Šira — Sorqan-Shira, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]

gegeġen: gegeġen — bright, shining; also 'brightness' (adjective/noun) [明] · also 'bright, clear' (Ming 明白 'plain, clear')
üdür: üdür — day [日] · also 'daytime, midday' (Ming 晝), in üdür düli naran 'the noon sun'
čeġeži-dür: čeġeži — diaphragm, breast (uncertain); dative-locative -dür, 'at the diaphragm' (noun + case) [胷膈 裏]
jabuba-že: jabu- — to walk, go about; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 行了 也者︀) [行了 也者︀]

keġebe: keġe- — to say; past -be, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]

nutuγlažu: nutuγla- — to camp, to occupy as pasture (from nutuγ, home ground); converb, 'camping' [營盤做着]
busu: busu — other, not so (adjective; Ming 別 'other, another') [別]

qorčilaγ̇ulžu: qorčila- — to bear the bow and quiver (from qorči 'quiver-bearer'; stem inferred from the Ming); causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making bear the bow' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎帶弓箭着]

sojurγarun: sojurγa- — to show favour, bestow grace; converb of time -run, 'when showing favour' (verb, converb of time) [恩賜時]

qojar-un: qojar — two; genitive -un, 'of the two' (numeral + case; Ming 兩的) [兩的]

üges: üge — word, saying; plural -s, 'words' (noun + plural) [言語每]
ker: ker — how, what manner (interrogative adverb; Ming 怎生); in ker ele, 'how, of what sort' [怎生]
qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇] · also before the thing counted: qojar sumu, 'two arrows' (Ming 兩隻 'two (arrows)')

ügüledkün: ügüle- — to speak, say; -dkün, polite plural imperative, 'say (you all)' (verb, imperative; analysis of the ending tentative) [說您]

qaγ̇ulžu: qaγ̇ul- — to rush, run; converb -žu, 'rushing' (verb, converb) [奔着] · also 'breaking, routing' (Ming 破着), Merkid irge qaγ̇ulžu 'routing the Merkid people'
olža: olža — booty, spoil, plunder (noun; Ming 財 'wealth') [財]
oluγ̇asu: ol- — to find, get; conditional -uγ̇asu, 'if (one) gets' (verb, conditional converb) [得呵]

oroγ̇a: oroγ̇a — cunning, wary (adjective; Ming 狡) [狡] · also 'wild' (Ming 野)

abalaγ̇asu: abala- — to hunt (stem inferred; Ming 打固 'hunt'); -γ̇asu conditional converb: if, when (back-vowel form) [打固呵]

darqalan: darqalan — free, at liberty (Ming 自在; analysis uncertain) [自在]

najaγ̇a: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名]
